name: B10–0209/2025 – § 3/2
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on energy-intensive industries
part_text: ‘suggests that additional ways to decouple fossil fuel prices from electricity prices be explored, in the framework of the EMD, including with the aim of boosting long-term contracts in line with the affordable energy action plan, and by advancing the analysis of short-term markets to 2025;’
